scope_note: The source explicitly calls object relations a branch of psychoanalytic theory while discussing Fairbairn. This does not imply that all object-relations theorists share one model or that the branch merely repeats Freud.
statement: The British Psychoanalytical Society describes object relations as a branch of psychoanalytic theory in which Fairbairn made important developments.
statement_zh: 英國精神分析學會把客體關係描述為精神分析理論的一個分支，並指出 Fairbairn 在其中作出重要發展。
